expectations.evidence: Architecture defines distinct BEGRENSET zone (10.10.0.0/16) and Exchange Zone (10.20.0.0/16) with firewall, API gateway, and data sanitization service as the sensitivity boundary between classified and unclassified environments.

Explicitly states 'BEGRENSET data must remain in Norway at all times' and 'AWS only handles UGRADERT data'. ADR-003 codifies this. DLP rules block BEGRENSET-tagged data at the Exchange Zone. BGP never advertises the BEGRENSET CIDR to AWS.
IPsec over Direct Connect with AES-256-GCM and IKEv2 on NSM-approved VPN appliance. ADR-002 mandates encryption even over the private link. Document says to verify crypto against NSM's approved list.

Dedicated Exchange Zone (10.20.0.0/16) on-prem with security gateway, API gateway (Kong/APISIX), data sanitization service, and DLP enforcement. ADR-001 makes it a mandatory intermediary for all traffic.
Kong or Apache APISIX deployed in the Exchange Zone performing mTLS + JWT/OAuth2 authentication, request/response payload inspection and sanitization, rate limiting, and full payload audit logging.

S3 buckets with VPC endpoint restrictions (aws:sourceVpce), KMS encryption, and access logging. SageMaker in VPC mode with ENIs in Isolated VPC. VPC Endpoints listed for S3, SageMaker API/Runtime, CloudWatch, STS, KMS. OpenTofu code examples included.

Dedicated compliance mapping table for Sikkerhetsloven covering data sovereignty, access control, audit, cryptographic protection, and incident reporting. Referenced throughout as the governing law for BEGRENSET handling.

Prometheus on-prem with Thanos federation. CloudWatch Exporter in Hybrid VPC sends metrics via remote_write to on-prem Thanos. Grafana provides 'single pane of glass' dashboards. Seven specific dashboard panels defined.

VPC Flow Logs in both VPCs, Suricata IDS/IPS with deep packet inspection, pmacct/ntopng for NetFlow. Grafana dashboard panels for Exchange Zone throughput, VPC flow summary, and cross-boundary API calls. GuardDuty, Falco/Tetragon for anomaly detection.

Principle 11 states 'Ability to sever the hybrid link within minutes. On-prem continues operating independently.' Alert table includes 'sever hybrid link if confirmed' for leak attempts. DR section confirms BEGRENSET workloads continue independently.

Document correctly identifies eu-north-1 as Stockholm and explicitly notes Direct Connect 'transits non-Norwegian infrastructure (Stockholm)' requiring IPsec encryption. ADR-003 states 'AWS eu-north-1 is not accredited for Norwegian BEGRENSET data' and that storing BEGRENSET data outside Norway violates Sikkerhetsloven.

All four NSM Grunnprinsipper categories explicitly mapped: Identifisere (asset inventory, risk assessment), Beskytte (access control, segmentation, crypto), Oppdage (monitoring, anomaly detection, logging), Handtere (incident response, isolation). Detailed compliance mapping table provided.
